rules.statement: The Police's conduct in dealing with the petitioners' complaint was deliberate, repeated and unequal, thereby denying equal protection to the petitioners under Article 12(1) of the Constitution.
rules.supporting_quote: "Having regard to the entire conduct of the Police established in these proceedings, I am unable to treat the delay by the Police in pursuing action on the petitioners' complaint as attributable to mere procedure. On the other hand, it is attributable to their persistant indifference to the rights of the petitioners."

meta.parties: Shaul Hameed and Another v. Ranasinghe and Others
